You've no idea how wonderful it is to see you.
say:1:1030301301:0.source_cn: 人……是人！\n天呐，看到你们不知道有多亲切。

say:2:1030301302:0.text: What happened? Ah... Yes, what happened indeed...
say:2:1030301302:0.source_cn: 发生了什么？啊……是啊，到底发生了什么来着……
say:2:1030301302:0.male: What happened? Ah... Yes, what happened indeed...
say:2:1030301302:0.female: What happened? Ah... Yes, what happened indeed...

say:3:1030301303:0.text: There was a group of gruglins... a crazy group of gruglins!
say:3:1030301303:0.source_cn: 一群咕布林，噢不，是一群发了疯的咕布林！
say:3:1030301303:0.male: There was a group of gruglins... a crazy group of gruglins!
say:3:1030301303:0.female: There was a group of gruglins... a crazy group of gruglins!

say:4:1030301304:0.text: They ate the grapes we were transporting... Those little bastards hijacked our carriage and attacked my friends Hessian and Pinkman.
say:4:1030301304:0.source_cn: 它们吃了我们运送的葡萄，啊哈哈……那群小畜生劫持了我们...
say:4:1030301304:0.male: They ate the grapes we were transporting... Those little bastards hijacked our carriage and attacked my friends Hessian and Pinkman.
say:4:1030301304:0.female: They ate the grapes we were transporting... Those little bastards hijacked our carriage and attacked my friends Hessian and Pinkman.

say:5:1030301305:0.text:
Now my grapes are gone. So are my friends!
To be honest, I'm not a big fan of grapes or my friends. Haha... There's nothing left to lose now.
